biography:
I help clients create strategies to navigate decarbonization, clean energy policy/regulations, new products and services, technology implementation, and stakeholder engagement. 

-Client types include electric utilities in North America and Canada, U.S. Department of Energy (DOE), and other federal and state government agencies. 

-Client engagements may cover distributed energy resources (DER) roadmaps and pilot design, grid modernization plans, distribution system planning (DSP), innovative business models, regulatory support, data privacy, cybersecurity, stakeholder engagement, and customer programs.
